description: Every US listed fund in a theme, largest first, with its fee and its share already in the S&P 500. For "what X ETFs are there" it returns the whole published set, not a sample.

limit.description: Most funds to return, largest net assets first. Default 50.

theme.description: Theme name or slug, matched loosely, such as cybersecurity or nuclear. etf_themes lists them.

name: etf_theme

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
